title: Agent run context
description: Shared input for every stage subagent in a migration run. Written by the coordinator at kickoff.

run_id.description: UUID for this migration run. All artifacts land in agents/out/<run_id>/.

foreign_catalog.description: UC foreign catalog name (read-only mirror of Azure SQL).

legacy_proc_schema.description: Schema in the source EDW containing the procs to migrate.

scoped_tables.description: Source tables in scope for the migration (schema.table).

max_retries.description: Max retry attempts for a failed gate decision. Read by on_subagent_stop.sh.

attempt.description: Current attempt number (0 = first pass). Incremented on each retry.
